description: Calibrated from microbenchmarks on nasrin0 (AMD EPYC 7763, host CPU). ALU/libm weights (pow_default, transcendental) are measured. The job had an NVIDIA A100 80GB PCIe and the binary was configured with CUDA 12.9 (sm_80), but the benchmark sources are host loops and did not run on the device; these are not A100 device weights. Memory/stencil weights retain the guestimates: a single-node streaming loop cannot reproduce the distributed-memory ghost-exchange costs those weights encode; see measurements.decisions. Previously unweighted functions (tan/sinh/cosh/tanh/erf) now carry measured weights.

decisions.pow_integer_floor: retained 2: integer-power streaming runs are at or below 1x add (pow2 0.10x through pown16 0.67x) and cannot resolve ALU scaling; log2 formula kept.
decisions.transcendental: measured per-function ratios. sqrt is 1.50x add on the transcendental probe (rounds to 1; pow sqrt_stream was 0.72x). cbrt is 9.72x on the transcendental probe (weight 10; pow cbrt_stream was 9.20x).
decisions.symbol_grid: retained 10: measured grid load is 0.20x add single-node, but the weight guides global-vs-local promotion where distributed costs dominate.
decisions.stencil: retained 10/40/100: measured center/x/y/z are 0.18x/0.18x/0.25x/0.22x add. The guestimates encode ghost-exchange costs this loop cannot reproduce.
decisions.div: streaming div is 1.50x add; register-isolated div is 3.70x add. div reaches the model via Pow[x**-1] with floor 2; left as is.
